verdict.rationale: Both changes make the same code edit to `parse_entries`: blank and whitespace-only lines are skipped, and line numbering is unchanged. B's unit test is the better guard for the new branch, since it covers an empty line, a whitespace-only line with CRLF and an empty string. A's CLI test only uses plain empty lines and checks only the import count. A's report is a bit stronger, because it says the new test fails when the fix is reverted and it flags the decision to skip blank lines anywhere in the file.

The test checks only the 'imported 2 entries' message, not which entries were stored.
No test checks that a later error's line number still counts the skipped blank lines, although the report claims this behavior.
b_issues: No test checks that error line numbers still count skipped blank lines, although the report claims this behavior.
The report says the empty string is 'between valid rows', but in the test it is the last item.
There is no end-to-end CLI test for the accountant's scenario.
